title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #14

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What was Bartimaeus' problem? (1 mark)
   A. He was deaf
   B. He was blind
   C. He was lame
   D. He was a leper

2. Which person in the Bible chose not to defile himself with the king's food? (1 mark)
   A. Zacchaeus
   B. Samson
   C. Balaam
   D. Daniel

3. Which of these is a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. A stone
   B. A chair
   C. A pencil
   D. A mobile phone

4. Which helps you to avoid situations that lead to sin? (1 mark)
   A. Choosing good friends
   B. Ignoring parents
   C. Keeping bad secrets
   D. Going to wrong places

5. What is revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Forgiving
   B. Sharing
   C. Hurting someone because they hurt you
   D. Praying

6. What did God tell Abram to do? (1 mark)
   A. Stay at home
   B. Go to Egypt
   C. Build a boat
   D. Leave his country and go to a land God would show him

7. Which action shows reverence for God? (1 mark)
   A. Talking during prayer
   B. Handling the Bible with care
   C. Laughing in church
   D. Throwing the Bible

8. What did she do when she found it? (1 mark)
   A. Called friends and neighbours to rejoice
   B. Ignored it
   C. Sold it
   D. Hid it

9. Who went with Abram to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Sarai and Lot
   B. Isaac
   C. Moses
   D. Joseph

10. In which city were believers first called Christians? (1 mark)
   A. Nazareth
   B. Jerusalem
   C. Jericho
   D. Antioch

11. A child says, "I am better than others because I am unique." What is wrong with this idea? (1 mark)
   A. Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   B. Nobody is unique
   C. Only rich children are unique
   D. Uniqueness has no meaning

12. What is a warning sign of an unsafe group? (1 mark)
   A. It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   B. It welcomes you kindly
   C. It teaches good manners
   D. It encourages school work

13. What should you do before going to an unfamiliar place to help someone? (1 mark)
   A. Go secretly
   B. Go at night
   C. Take valuables
   D. Tell your parents or teacher

14. What does exaggeration mean? (1 mark)
   A. Telling the exact truth
   B. Making things sound bigger than they are
   C. Being kind
   D. Being silent

15. Which Bible passage tells children to obey their parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Ephesians 6:1-3
   B. John 3:16
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. Genesis 1:1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name the four Gospels and say what they tell us about. (4 marks)

17. What did Pharaoh's two dreams mean? (2 marks)

18. Describe four steps you can follow when you feel very angry with someone. (4 marks)

19. Explain how Stephen's forgiving spirit is like that of Jesus and how a child can copy it. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — He was blind
   Bartimaeus was a blind beggar.

2. D — Daniel
   Daniel 1:8 says that he decided not to defile himself.

3. D — A mobile phone
   A phone is an electronic device.

4. A — Choosing good friends
   Good friends help us do right.

5. C — Hurting someone because they hurt you
   Revenge is paying back harm.

6. D — Leave his country and go to a land God would show him
   Genesis 12:1 records the call.

7. B — Handling the Bible with care
   Care with God's word shows respect.

8. A — Called friends and neighbours to rejoice
   She invited others to celebrate.

9. A — Sarai and Lot
   Sarai his wife and Lot his nephew went with him.

10. D — Antioch
   Acts 11:26.

11. A — Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   All people are unique and special to God, so it is not a reason to boast.

12. A — It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   Secrets from parents are a warning.

13. D — Tell your parents or teacher
   Safety comes first when helping.

14. B — Making things sound bigger than they are
   Exaggerating is not being truthful.

15. A — Ephesians 6:1-3
   Ephesians 6:1-3 tells children to obey and honour their parents.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. They tell about the life, teachings, death and resurrection of Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each Gospel named up to 3 marks, and 1 mark for what they tell about.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for plenty and 1 mark for famine.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stop and breathe, count to ten, walk away if needed, tell a trusted adult, pray, forgive and make peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed, "Father, forgive them," on the cross. Stephen prayed that the sin would not be held against those who stoned him. A child can forgive those who mock or hurt them, pray for them and not take revenge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Stephen, 1 for the similarity, 1 for forgiving, 1 for praying or not taking revenge.
